objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact that is created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated and translated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected when creating a new document; examples include policy, guideline, procedural instruction and work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents for clarity and evaluation options.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation assigned to documents; not language-independent and same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to documents and adaptable to requirements.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute in which the creator is automatically confirmed by default and which determines the registered author for workflow signing.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights; co-authors have no relevance within the release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for the review step.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for release, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date based on release of a document and updated for each newly released version.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which a validity check is necessary; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for archiving documents; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects distribution of workflow tasks when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type that documents locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type that describes specific procedures within a guideline framework or process sequence details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to document special detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or on which new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type that supplements a document with additional information and can be released and published directly via properties switches.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: equipment
objs.description: Relevant equipment or document attachment mentioned as supplementing documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, initiator or other system user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorizations, reader assignments, role assignment, distribution and archive access.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to groups or persons for documents.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task in workflow processes that users complete, including release, acknowledgement, validity extension, override and reactivation tasks.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created and managed for a document without affecting content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and processed automatically by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for re-validating invalidated documents and starting the reactivation workflow.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Distribution list assignment of user groups and persons to documents for read authorization, e-mail information, acknowledgement and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: E-mail information sent to involved users about workflow tasks, document releases, change proposals, validity extension, override and acknowledgement.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific view filled using distribution groups and listing documents relevant to users.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data object with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of released document content visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language after release.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new information object.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more defined document templates when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploading files or generating documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Open and maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain document metadata grouped in categories.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit content with an implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document_as_pdf
evts.description: Display the current version on the web as a converted PDF.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Change a released document, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new version in editing status when a valid and released document is revised or when changes require a new version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign authorizations for readers via a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Enter or change the person in the Author field for a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers maintained in document attributes for checking.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers maintained in document attributes for release.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Add an object of type Additional info to a document.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify additional information associated with a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an Attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Initiate the 3-step release process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes release so the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: Reject during review, canceling workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: Reject during release, canceling workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature or acknowledgement task without signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: print_signature
evts.description: Print signatures as document content.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, causing a new version to be created in editing status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: inform_document_author
evts.description: Inform the author of the underlying document by e-mail when a Change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: notify_proposal_creator
evts.description: Send an e-mail notification to the creator of a proposal after editing is documented.

evts.name: manage_change_proposal
evts.description: Create and manage Change proposals in the Cockpit for a document in the Change proposals folder.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: check_validity
evts.description: Check whether the document is still valid, needs revision, or must be invalidated.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension, and update the Valid until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised version is released or when suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Start workflow for processing the request for AKS automatically after attachment of the request.

evts.name: process_aks
evts.description: Carry out AKS by releaser or through initiator, reviewer and releaser checks.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare released documents and their attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke all authorizations except those for the archive group during archiving.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Start the workflow automatically after request for reactivation is created.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the reactivation request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents by creating a new document version and restoring properties and authorizations.

evts.name: reactivate_equipment
evts.description: Reactivate Equippments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons assigned to Distribution in the cockpit for the document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request recipients by e-mail to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify author team when all persons maintained in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups assigned to the document.

evts.name: list_document
evts.description: List all documents relevant to the user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: display_document_detail
evts.description: Display detailed information for a selected document, such as attachments, additional information, referenced documents and language versions.

evts.name: evaluate_instruction
evts.description: Evaluate instructions stored in the system with additional information depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: evaluate_editing_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents saved in the system in editing status with additional information depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents stored in the system with revision cycle depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: evaluate_workflow_status
evts.description: Evaluate documents stored in the system to determine current workflow status.

evts.name: list_acknowledgement
evts.description: List acknowledgements depending on status.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the DHC VISION system into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: assign_translation_participant
evts.description: Assign participants for checking and releasing translation in the properties dialog of the document.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from the local document to the original document.

o2o.description: One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new document objects.
A pure object cover can be created for external files or generated documents.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with other documents; a local document can reference an original document.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with Master data.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments are associated with a main document and released with it.
Documents can be supplemented with relevant Equippments, and archived Equippments are reactivated with the document.
Users can be assigned as readers, authors, co-authors, reviewers, releasers, translators, initiators and distribution persons for a document.
User groups can be assigned to documents for reader authorization, authorizations, distribution and archive access.
Read and change rights are assigned specifically to documents.
Users are assigned to User Groups by technical administration.
Authorizations for readers are assigned via user group assignment.
Personal authorizations are assigned for author, co-author, reviewer and releaser.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Distribution list assignments are maintained per document.
Persons assigned to Distribution receive read authorization and notifications or acknowledgement tasks.
User Groups assigned to Distribution receive read authorization and determine users notified or requested to acknowledge.
Acknowledgements relate to the current document version and are summarized for the author team.
E-mail notifications are sent about document workflow tasks, release, change proposals, validity extension, override and acknowledgement.
Users involved in workflow receive and complete workflow tasks.
Workflow participants complete release workflow tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released document version.
Documents relevant to a user are assigned in dashboards based on distribution groups.
Reports evaluate documents in the system depending on selected parameters.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
Released documents can have translated language versions visible to authorized readers after release.
